title: Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
meta_description: Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok review: 43,000+ runners on 30 November 2025, course records of 2:14:27 and 2:39:27, and an early sell-out.
dek: Bangkok's big marathon set course records and drew more than 43,000 runners across its distances in November 2025. Here is what that edition was like, ahead of 2026.
verdict: The Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok is the capital's big-city marathon. The race, on 30 November 2025, drew 43,525 participants across all distances according to the official results, with about 5,000 in the marathon, and entries closed early [1]. Both course records fell: Ethiopia's Agunafr Bekele won the men's race in 2:14:27 and Kenya's Eunice Muchiri the women's in 2:39:27 [1]. If you want a major marathon in Bangkok with a fast front of the field, enter as soon as registration opens.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: The 2025 race was held on 30 November 2025 [1]. The official results list 43,525 participants across all distances, and about 5,000 in the marathon alone, and demand led the organisers to close registration early [1].
The race dates from 2018, and since 2024 it has started from a new location in central Bangkok [1].

sections.heading: Course Records
paragraphs: Both marathon course records were set in 2025. Agunafr Bekele of Ethiopia won the men's race in 2:14:27, and Eunice Muchiri of Kenya won the women's in 2:39:27 [1].
Most of the field, though, will be running for the experience of an early-morning Bangkok marathon rather than for a time.

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a big international marathon in Bangkok. Entries sold out early in 2025, so register as soon as you can.
Plan around the heat. Bangkok in late November is still warm, so pace to conditions.
This review is compiled from the Wikipedia summary of the race and its official 2025 results. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok in 2025?
faqs.answer: The official results list 43,525 participants across all distances on 30 November 2025, with about 5,000 in the marathon alone. Registration closed early because of demand.

faqs.question: What are the Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok course records?
faqs.answer: Both were set in 2025: 2:14:27 by Ethiopia's Agunafr Bekele for men and 2:39:27 by Kenya's Eunice Muchiri for women.

faqs.question: When is the Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok?
faqs.answer: In late November. The 2025 race was on 30 November, and the 2026 edition is scheduled for the weekend of 28 and 29 November.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-28 about the previous edition (30 November 2025). Replaces a pre-race preview. Wikipedia gives two participant figures (43,525 in its infobox, citing the official results, and over 48,000 in its text); the results-backed figure is used. No rating.
